name: mstack-epic
description: Details one epic for product and management people, from an approved product plan or from a description in chat. Interviews only what the detailed epic adds, then writes one document: outcome, who it is for, what is in and out, acceptance as plain statements, a measurable result, size, fixed limits, user stories and open questions for developers. It never edits the product plan and lists what changed. No code and no development steps. mstack-write-specs accepts the approved epic as its source. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.
